admission_price: $20 per person (online via Eventbrite plus $4.41 processing fees, or $20 at farm ticket window with cash or card)
activities: haunted house walk-through with live actors; haunted cannabis maze; theatrical haunted attraction with special effects and animatronics; blackout event (lights-out maze experience); hemp maze; canna disc golf; concessions
season_dates: October 9, 10, 16, 17, 23, 24, 30, & 31, 2026 (7 PM - 11 PM, Friday & Saturday nights)
extra_notes: Two separate paid experiences: Theatrical Haunted Attraction (7-10 PM, suggested ages 10-99, under 13 must be accompanied by adult) and Blackout Event (10-11 PM, all lights out, one LED candle per group). Each requires a separate ticket. No refunds issued. Children 15 and under must have responsible adult on site at all times. Strobe lights, fog machines, lasers, and loud sounds present - not recommended for those with certain medical conditions, pregnancy, claustrophobia, or mobility limitations. No photography/videotaping allowed. Open rain, snow, or sleet; dress warmly as walking between buildings and through maze outdoors. Concessions available 6 PM - 11 PM. Glow sticks available for scared patrons. Online tickets can be printed or downloaded; must check in at online ticket tent. On-site ticket window open Friday & Saturday 6:30 PM - 11 PM (cash or card accepted). Hemp Maze and Canna Disc Golf separate activities ($10 per person, August 22 - October 11, weekends only).
